statement: Sailing is unlocked in World 5 and is fairly complicated.
The Trader is unlocked using an artifact.
Click and drag a Captain from the Port Area to an island to start the journey and its timer.
The Port Area holds all Captains with their boats until you choose an island.
Travel is one-way: 25 meters to the island and 25 back.
Minimum time requirement is 105 minutes each way or 210 minutes for the round trip.
Selecting an island shows its name and the resource you gain from it.
Artifacts have 3 stages: black box (not found) and green check (first bonus unlocked).
Ancient Form is about 100x rarer than base form so may take many trips.
Yellow check mark is the Ancient Form and unlocks the secondary bonus.
Each island has a different travel distance.
Stick with one island until boats have enough speed to cover the distance in the minimum time.
Without enough speed it takes much longer to gain loot which slows overall progression.
Exception to sticking with an island: going to a specific island for a specific artifact.
Stay on Beginner Islands until speed can make the Beachy Coast round trip in about four hours instead of days.
Travel distances get insane at later islands so speed matters even more.
You start with only Safari Island until you unlock Cloud 1 or 2.
Clouds have the same travel distance as the island so travel takes the same time.
Do not go to clouds without enough speed or you waste time going back and forth.
Example: Cloud 10 would take about a day one way and 2 days for one unit of progress; weeks to unlock.
Show Identity button displays boat numbers and captain letters on the map crew tab and docks.
Use the identity labels to decide if a boat's speed is high enough for a particular island.
Keep Minimum Chest on Wooden Chest as much as possible.
To keep Wooden Chest minimum you should check the game every hour or two.
Nearly every trip gives a Wooden Chest depending on boat speed.
If you cannot check often move the minimum chest up to Iron Chest or higher if checking every couple days.
Return Ship button returns a selected ship to port to reset the journey or choose a new island.
Returning a ship cancels the journey at any point and you gain no loot from it.
There are six Captain tiers (white red bandana tier 1; pink tier 2; blue tier 4).
Tiers only raise the maximum value of bonuses not the minimum.
Tier 1 boat speed is 1-4% while tier 2 is 1-11%.
A higher tier is not necessarily better since tier roll is separate from value rolls.
Even a Tier 6 Captain can be worse than a Tier 1 Captain.
Each Captain can have up to 2 bonuses; replace a Captain with only 1 bonus as soon as possible.
Five bonuses: Boat Speed (green icon) Loot Value Artifact Find Chance Cloud Discover Rate and Rare Chest Chance.
Boat Speed is first priority on Captains: speed is king and more trips mean more loot.
Loot Value is a very close second priority: more loot means more upgrades and more speed.
Artifact Find Chance is third priority but only have a few Captains with it.
Do not invest heavily in Artifact Find Chance since it's not needed once all artifacts are found.
Cloud Discover Rate is fourth: lets you unlock clouds faster then go back to Speed and Loot Captains.
Rare Chest Chance last and recommended only later in the game as it adds loot value.
Rare Chests give more loot in general so Rare Chest Chance is useful at any point but not early focus.
Ideal Captains have Speed and Loot Value to maximize benefit.
Boat speed won't be needed eventually once all boats are level 300 or similar.
Captains must be out of boats and walking on docks to be trashed.
Trashing deletes the Captain and you must hire a replacement so be careful.
Captain level is a multiplier for its bonuses.
Example: level 1 gives 15% Rare Chest Chance and level 2 gives 30%.
His level 10 Captain has a base 4% Boat Speed and he wants to replace it soon.
Unlocking later-level Captains costs lots of gold and each needs a boat with different resources.
Spending gold too early on Captains when you can't upgrade boats is a waste.
Boats tab Loot Value includes boat and captain values; the game does the math.
Loot Value is a multiplier for loot from each treasure chest the boat brings back.
His boat travels about 200000 meters per hour; for the 300000 meter minimum distance it takes under 2 hours.
Goal is an island whose distance the boat covers in the minimum time.
At this speed he gets a treasure chest in a little under four hours.
An island taking 5 hours each way means a 10 hour round trip per chest.
Find an island the boat can travel in under the minimum time.
Artifact Odds Chance is a multiplier for artifact odds from chests that boat brings back.
Every boat has different loot and artifact multipliers.
Boat 1 requires gold to upgrade Loot and Speed.
Boat 2 requires gold for Loot and Safari Fruits for Speed.
Ignore Boats 2 3 and 4 until much later.
Spend all gold on Boat 1 for best value.
Spend Safari Fruits on Boat 5 Loot Value upgrades.
He ignored his own advice early because he did not know; this is most effective until you can spend thousands freely.
Every 8 upgrade levels gives a large stat jump (about 5000 loot vs 200 per normal upgrade).
Break points are separate for Loot and Speed.
You need 8 individual levels in a stat to reach its break point; 3 Loot and 5 Speed won't combine.
One speed upgrade gave about 30000 speed versus 2000 normally for similar resources.
You can switch which boat a Captain is in by selecting the boat and clicking the white box to remove them.
Captain recruitment area resets each daily reset and should be checked regularly for the best Captains.
Early game it may take several days to hire enough Captains.
Pillars unlock by level: 1 at first then level 15 25 and 35 for the second third and fourth.
Captain tier is completely random from 0 to 6.
Captain traits are random; any of 5 choices can be in either slot.
Trait values are random so good Captains need RNG.
Hire cost is a set amount of gold; higher tier costs more.
Example tier 3 Captain: 9% Boat Speed (max 18) and 21% Cloud Discover (max 31).
Tier 3 example Captain is fairly useless but fine if it is the best you have.
Avoid the Tier 2 Captain with poor rolls and 2x Cloud Discover Rate as you need speed to reach clouds.
Third choice with Loot and Artifact Find low rolls is a trash Captain.
Tier 5 Captain with 34% Loot Value (max 55) and Rare Chest up to 22% is a good roll.
He prefers Speed over Loot and Rare Chest so won't waste gold on the good tier 5 Captain.
Loot Pile shows resources; gold bars come from any island and nearly any chest.
Each island gives its own resource plus a chance at that island's rare resource.
From Boat 6 you need rare resources to upgrade Speed; boats 6 7 8 and 9 need rare resources 6 7 8 and 9.
Later boats need rare resources harder to obtain so you spend more time on particular islands.
Miracle Chest is the highest and rare; you can buy 3 per day in the Gem Shop.
Each chest tier gives another roll of resources: Wooden 1 roll and Iron 2 rolls.
Rarer chests give more loot overall; if you can't check often Iron Chests give more value for AFK time.
Example chest opening gave 2 gold piles and 3 resource piles.
Lollipop Island chest had under 1% artifact chance; Iron gives 2 rolls and Gilded gives 3 rolls.
Open chests each day to collect treasure and hope for artifacts.
The Trader lets you sell a random resource for gold; it needs specific amounts of a specific resource.
The Trader is unlocked by the Emerald Relic found on Isolated Woods Island.
Extra Trader gold lets you upgrade Boat 1 higher and unlock more pirate or boat slots.
Gold is also needed for an Alchemy bubble and a Divinity Statue level up.
Trader is a way to use leftover unneeded resources especially after leveling boats.
Relics give big benefits across the entire game and always apply once found.
Fauxory Tusk is found relatively early and gives Artifact Find Chance per Sailing Level.
Ancient Form doubles Fauxory Tusk; he gains another 100% Artifact Find Chance.
Genie Lamp gives more Loot Value per Sailing Level; unlock it as soon as possible.
Don't worry about Genie Lamp Ancient Form early but at least unlock the base form.
10 AD Tablet gives Sailing Speed for every 10 items found after 500 in the Slab.
Other artifact benefits include doubling Shrine bonuses and placing anywhere plus more Printer Samples and Post Office Boxes.
Fury Relic gives more Max Talent Book Level at the Library which changes the game.
Sailboat Stamp in World 1 gives Sailing Speed.
Sailboat Stamp bonus is doubled by the Laboratory bonus in World 4.
World 1 Statue bonuses give a small Sailing Speed bump.
Unlock the Golden Statue with a few Dementia Coin to make the statue benefit account wide.
Sailor at Heart is a large bubble that must be equipped and gives a really good gain.
Sailor at Heart gives a chance for more Sailing progress when you collect AFK gains.
Log into one character at a time and check Sailing progress between to maximize Sailor at Heart procs and chests.
Sailor at Heart proc is small chance so may not proc on every character; watch when collecting AFK gains.
Boaty Bubble gives flat Sailing Speed at a good rate but costs many Gaming Pixels.
OJ Jooce vial gives Sailing Speed and is doubled by the Lab bonus; cheap and good.
Hampter Drippy vial gives more Sailing EXP but Hampters are rare drops.
An artifact unlocks a new Post Office crate giving AFK counts for Sailing and minor bonuses.
The Post Office box is a lot of boxes to spend for a very small gain.
Popped Corn dinner menu gives 2% Sailing Speed per plate level.
There are no active Sailing benefits in World 3.
Goat Statue gives 4% Sailing Speed per level as a passive blessing.
Goat Statue needs Gaming Bits to level up but is a decent bonus.
Linking a character to Purrmep Statue gives 22.7% Boat Sailing Speed.
Link a higher level Divinity character to Purrmep Statue since the bonus scales with Divinity level.
Purrmep blessing gives about 3% Sailing Speed per level and only needs coins to level.
Newly updated Siege Breaker has 4 new Sailing talents; first is Unending Loot Search.
Unending Loot Search lets chests in the Loot Pile be upgraded.
Unending Loot Search does not add chests but replaces a Wooden Chest with a better one brought back.
Unending Loot Search gives about 35% more chest loot at 100 points.
Expertly Sailed gives more Sailing EXP to all characters though Sailing is a shared level.
More Sailing level raises artifact values based on Sailing Level.
Captain Peptalk gives more Captain EXP so Captains level faster for more multiplier on bonuses.
Archlord of the Pirates gives more EXP and Drop Rate per power of 10 kills of Plunderous Mobs.
Plunderous Mobs come from using the Pirate Flag.
Play Siege Breaker actively to get more Plunderous Mob kills; benefit applies to all characters.
The 4 Sailing talents must be on the Active talent preset not a secondary preset.
Siege Breaker has a Family Bonus giving faster minimum boat travel time.
Base minimum is 2 hours; his Siege Breaker has 12.4% faster giving 105 minutes versus 120.
Leveling Siege Breaker and keeping these talents active greatly increases Sailing gains.
